<!-- Google tag (gtag.js) -- both GA4 properties + Google Ads.
     Timing (ads lane, 2026-10-20): the gtag.js script is fetched after the
     window load event, i.e. after first paint. It is never gated on a tap
     or scroll, which would lose the Google click cookie and the pageview
     when a visitor's first tap is a navigation. Exception: the thank-you
     pages load it immediately, because the form conversion fires there
     with no interaction. A 5 s fallback covers pages whose load event is
     held up by a slow iframe (the Jotform pages). The config calls queue
     in dataLayer and replay the moment the script runs. -->
<script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
  gtag('js', new Date());
  gtag('config', 'G-PHLC29WGVN');
  gtag('config', 'G-D3RBZZ5WPL');
  gtag('config', 'AW-354317910');
  (function(w,d){
    var done = false;
    function load(){
      if (done) return; done = true;
      var s = d.createElement('script'); s.async = true;
      s.src = 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-PHLC29WGVN';
      d.head.appendChild(s);
    }
    var immediate = /^\/thank-you(-confirmation)?(\.html)?\/?$/.test(w.location.pathname);
    if (immediate || d.readyState === 'complete') { load(); return; }
    w.addEventListener('load', load, {once: true});
    w.setTimeout(load, 5000);
  })(window, document);
</script>

<!-- Hotjar Tracking Code -- loads on the first scroll, tap, mouse move
     or key press (ads lane, 2026-10-20: it carries no attribution, so it
     stays out of the way of first paint). No interaction, no recording. -->
<script>
  (function(h,o,t,j){
    h.hj=h.hj||function(){(h.hj.q=h.hj.q||[]).push(arguments)};
    h._hjSettings={hjid:5016360,hjsv:6};
    var evs=['mousemove','touchstart','pointerdown','keydown','scroll'], done=false;
    function load(){
      if (done) return; done = true;
      evs.forEach(function(e){ o.removeEventListener(e, load); });
      var r=o.createElement('script');r.async=1;
      r.src=t+h._hjSettings.hjid+j+h._hjSettings.hjsv;
      o.head.appendChild(r);
    }
    evs.forEach(function(e){ o.addEventListener(e, load, {passive:true}); });
  })(window,document,'https://static.hotjar.com/c/hotjar-','.js?sv=');
</script>
